preconditions.description: Input integers n (vertices) and m (edges) are within the bounds 1 to 10^5.
Number of vertices n is at least 1, and edges m is non-negative.

postconditions.description: Output is either 'Impossible' or starts with 'Possible' followed by valid edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(stdout.split()) - 1 == m and all(1 <= int(v) <= n and 1 <= int(u) <= n and int(v) != int(u) for line in stdout.split()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()]))
postconditions.description: If 'Possible', output contains exactly m edges, each with distinct vertices in [1, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (all(math.gcd(int(v), int(u)) == 1 for line in stdout.split()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()]))
postconditions.description: Every edge (v, u) in the output satisfies GCD(v, u) = 1.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len(set(v for line in stdout.split()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()])) == n and len(set(u for line in stdout.split()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()])) == n)
postconditions.description: The graph is connected (all vertices are reachable via edges).

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Impossible' or (len({(min(int(v), int(u)), max(int(v), int(u))) for line in stdout.split()[1:] for v, u in [line.split()]}) == m)
postconditions.description: No duplicate edges or self-loops exist in the output.
